# 📚 Machine Learning Foundations

Welcome! 

I'm building this repository while learning the mathematical and statistical foundations of Machine Learning from scratch.

Rather than simply collecting notes, my goal is to create beginner-friendly Jupyter notebooks that explain concepts intuitively, introduce the underlying mathematics step by step, and connect them to real-world applications in Machine Learning, Remote Sensing, GIS, and Environmental Data Science.

This repository serves as both my personal learning journal and an open educational resource for anyone beginning their own Machine Learning journey.

---

## 🎯 Project Goals

The main goals of this project are to:

* Build a strong foundation in Machine Learning prerequisites.
* Learn concepts through understanding rather than memorization.
* Create high-quality Jupyter notebooks for future review.
* Share my learning journey publicly on GitHub and LinkedIn.
* Develop a portfolio that demonstrates continuous learning and technical communication.

---

## 📖 Repository Structure

```text
Machine-Learning-Foundations/

├── Probability/
├── Statistics/
├── Linear_Algebra/
├── Calculus/
├── Python/
└── Resources/
```

Each notebook follows a consistent structure:

*  Learning Objectives
*  Why This Matters in Machine Learning
*  Intuition
*  Mathematical Definition
*  Worked Examples
*  Machine Learning Applications
*  Python Examples (when appropriate)
*  Key Takeaways
*  Summary
